label: Demo Policy Pack
notice: A deliberately simplified demonstration set, sufficient to build the prototype. These are not RAMIFY OS production rules and must not be represented as such.

severities.hard_stop: The product cannot be trusted regardless of what else is true. No actor may soften it.
severities.incomplete: The system could not gather enough to decide. Says nothing about the product either way.
severities.policy_dependent: A real finding whose weight depends on who is asking.
severities.informational: Recorded for the audit trail. Does not move the posture on its own.

checks.label: Identity resolution
checks.question: Does this identifier resolve to exactly one known subject?

checks.label: Recall and advisory standing
checks.question: Is this product or batch under an active recall or advisory?

checks.label: Seller authority
checks.question: Is the seller established as authorised to supply this category?

checks.label: Mandatory evidence present
checks.question: Is every evidence type this category requires actually attached?

checks.label: Evidence validity and integrity
checks.question: Is the attached evidence still within its validity period?

checks.label: Claims and category requirements
checks.question: Are the required claims present, from an issuer with authority to make them, and not rejected or revoked?

checks.label: Conflicting information
checks.question: Do two issuers state materially different values for the same claim type?

precedence.note: RESOLVE Demo Specification v0.4 section 7.2, corrected by amendment v0.4.1 item 4: five action postures, six precedence rules. All applicable conditions are evaluated. The most restrictive matched posture determines the outcome; precedence order determines the primary explanatory reason. A reason code is recorded for every condition matched, not only the primary one.

rules.condition: any check failed with hard_stop severity
at least one check needs review, no check failed or is incomplete, standing clean
every check passed and standing clean

supersession.note: Client direction of 22 July 2026, item 2. A replacement product is a relationship and a possible next action, never a posture of its own.

ingredient_claim.note: For EPA/DHA ingredient claims, values within 5 mg per component are treated as within tolerance. Other ingredient formats fall back to exact normalised comparison.
